compiled_state.title: [ci-tests]: CLAUDE.md trim left 18+ stale grep-tests across Hook and Script Tests
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 89f9e8ef7c3708da755b586e04594c4ed98d2fe7
* **upstream cause:** commit 71daf13b98 (PR #66 origin/main) 'docs(claude-md): trim CLAUDE.md and externalize reference content'

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior — CI failures on PR #67 (also fail on main)

#### Expected Behavior

After CLAUDE.md is trimmed (per CLAUDE.md governance rule that feature/implementation docs belong elsewhere), the structural grep tests in tests/scripts/test-claude-md-*.sh and tests/hooks/test-review-gate-allowlist.sh must either:
(a) Be updated to grep the new home of the moved content (e.g., codebase-overview.md, CI-INTEGRATION.md, HOOKS-REFERENCE.md, AGENTS.md), OR
(b) Be removed if the assertion no longer applies after the trim.

PR #66 (the trim) shipped without updating these tests, breaking required-check CI on main and on every subsequent PR including #67.

#### Actual Behavior

CI 'Hook Tests' and 'Script Tests' (both required-check contexts per .github/required-checks.txt) fail with 19+ assertion failures across these files:

- tests/hooks/test-review-gate-allowlist.sh: 1 failure (CLAUDE.md references review-gate-allowlist)
- tests/scripts/test-check-referential-integrity.sh: 1 failure (test_real_files_pass)
- tests/scripts/test-claude-md-ci-review.sh: 9 failures (ci-llm-review-runner.sh, llm-api-call.sh, .dso-source-of-truth, fan-out, 'does not consult', CI version resolution, 3-tier, falls back to, dso-dev)
- tests/scripts/test-claude-md-fix-bug-gates.sh: 2 failures (CLI_user/intent-aligned phrases)
- tests/scripts/test-claude-md-hook-error-handler.sh: 4 failures (register_hook_err_handler, enforcement_boundary_header, canonical_log_path, hook_error_handler_path)
- tests/scripts/test-claude-md-replan-safety.sh: 1 failure (test_claude_md_contains_replan_escalate)
- tests/scripts/test-claude-md-rule18-task-auth.sh: 1 failure (test_rule18_task_instructions_not_approval, refs bug 859b-b48b)

### 3. Action History

1. PR #66 trimmed CLAUDE.md
2. PR #66 merged to main (CI was already failing — required checks not enforced before merge?)
3. PR #67 (this branch) inherited the failure via the merge-from-main commit 39830cee70

### 6. Logs

```
=== Hook Tests Summary ===
Hook Tests: PASSED: 2197  FAILED: 1
=== Script Tests Summary ===
Script Tests: PASSED: 712  FAILED: 18
```

comments.body: Classification: behavioral (single shared root cause: PR #66 trim left grep-tests asserting absent content). Score: 3 (INTERMEDIATE). Intent Gate: skipped (CLI_user).
